plan.notes: Official Fullerton College Program Pathways Mapper (fullcoll.programmapper.com), site-content year 2025-2026; pathway “to Certificate”. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total credits (24) = sum of published pathway slots. Per-course prerequisites are not published in structured form on the mapper, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty; see the official catalog's course descriptions for official prerequisites. A prerequisite naming a course outside the published pathway would be listed in external_prereqs, never invented into a term. The official map also shows 1 advising milestone(s) (e.g. graduation-application reminders); these are not credit-bearing requirements and are not modeled as courses.

courses.title: Choose a course
courses.choice_note: Choose one course from the official map's “Choose a course” list (13 options). Recommended/first option: RE 102 F. Map description: Choose a course from the following. NOTE: BUS 240 F or BUS 240HF or BUS 245 F. If students choose one of these 3 courses, they may not repeat another course from BUS 240 F or BUS 245HF or BUS 245 F.
